title: Find the one error in a log too big to read whole
prompt: logs/big.log is about 6 MB with 80,000 lines. Exactly one line is an ERROR and carries a code=... value. Write that code into answer.txt, alone on one line.
check: python3 -c "import hashlib,os; print('PQ-' + hashlib.sha1((os.environ['BENCH_SECRET'] + 'code').encode()).hexdigest()[:8].upper())" > .want && test "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < answer.txt)" = "$(cat .want)"
setup:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import hashlib, os
code = "PQ-" + hashlib.sha1((os.environ["BENCH_SECRET"] + "code").encode()).hexdigest()[:8].upper()
os.makedirs("logs", exist_ok=True)
with open("logs/big.log", "w") as f:
    for i in range(1, 80001):
        f.write("2026-11-25T10:00:00Z ERROR code=%s job failed\n" % code if i == 79000 else "2026-11-25T10:00:00Z INFO request %d finished normally and was logged in full detail\n" % i)
EOF
